turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I am intrigued, Your Majesty. May I be so bold as to ask, what is the nature of this scandal that threatens the House of Ormstein?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, Dr. Watson, that I am in a most precarious position. The revelation of my...ahem...private life could have far-reaching consequences, not only for myself, but for the entire European balance of power.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see that you, Your Majesty, have placed great reliance upon discretion and secrecy to protect your interests. Pray tell, what is the nature of this scandal that threatens to compromise your position?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I am finding it increasingly difficult to understand the nature of this scandal. Can you tell me, is it a matter of personal conduct, or is it something more...substantial?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Gentlemen, I must confess that the situation is becoming increasingly...perilous. The scandal, I fear, is not merely a matter of personal conduct, but one that threatens to compromise the very foundations of my...ahem...position.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that you share with us the specifics of this scandal, that we may better understand the nature of the threat you face.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Gentlemen, I beg of you, be assured that I am not merely being frivolous or capricious in my concern for secrecy. My reputation, my very position, hangs precariously in the balance.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must reiterate, Your Majesty, that we are not merely curious observers, but also sworn to uphold the law and protect the innocent. I beg of you, for the sake of justice and the greater good, to reveal the specifics of this scandal.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that if I were to reveal the specifics of this scandal, it would not only compromise my position, but also put innocent lives at risk. I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand that I am caught in a delicate web of intrigue, and any misstep could have far-reaching consequences.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must confess, Your Majesty, that I am beginning to grasp the gravity of your situation, and I daresay, the consequences of inaction may be catastrophic. I implore you, for the sake of your position and the well-being of those involved, to trust us with the full extent of the scandal.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that I am at a loss for how to proceed, gentlemen, and I implore you, if you are to assist me in this matter, to be cautious, for the fate of my kingdom, nay, of Europe itself, hangs precariously in the balance.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I suppose, Your Majesty, that you are not accustomed to sharing your secrets with those outside your circle, but I assure you that discretion is the hallmark of my profession. I implore you, be specific about the nature of this scandal, and let us proceed with all due haste.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that I am torn between my duty to my kingdom and the need for candor, and I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand that this is a matter of utmost gravity and delicacy.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I am not one to be swayed by vague threats or appeals to duty. I require facts, and I require them now, in order to determine the best course of action.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that the thought of betraying my trust in this matter weighs heavily upon me, and I fear that, should I reveal the truth, I may be forced to abdicate my throne, with potentially disastrous consequences for the future of Europe.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that you reveal the specifics of this scandal, no matter how painful or compromising it may be, for I am not a politician, but a detective, and it is my duty to uncover the truth.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall reveal all, but I beg of you, gentlemen, to assure me that you will not betray my confidence, for the consequences of such a breach would be catastrophic, not only for me, but for the entire kingdom.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am bound by the same sense of duty as my dear friend Sherlock here, and I give you my word that any confidence you entrust to us shall be respected and protected, I assure you.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Gentlemen, I beg of you, do not think me a fool, for I have already walked a path of great danger to reach this point, and I fear that if I do not find a solution to this dilemma, my very existence will be forfeit.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I shall not pry into the details of your personal life, Your Majesty, but rather focus on the facts that will lead me to the truth. Tell me, what specific evidence or information do you possess that could compromise your throne?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
